# Tim Berry on Bplans

> Tim Berry's insights on business planning, entrepreneurship, and startup strategy with practical guides and personal reflections on building successful companies.

Tim Berry is a founding member of Palo Alto Software and a recognized expert in business planning. This site features his business planning guides, financial forecasting resources, and entrepreneurial commentary spanning from practical how-to articles to reflections on startup culture, leadership, and business philosophy.

## Key Topics

- Business Planning
- Entrepreneurship
- Startup Funding
- Financial Planning
- Cash Flow Management
- Business Strategy
- Investor Relations
- Startup Advice
- LivePlan
- Business Philosophy
- Leadership
- Competitive Analysis
- Startup Guide
- Financial Forecasting
- Business Plan Outline

## Business Planning Guides

- [Create Your Business Plan](https://timberry.bplans.com/create-your-business-plan.php): Guide to creating a business plan with strategy and financial forecasting
- [Cash Flow Statement: Definition + How to Create and Read it](https://timberry.bplans.com/10-critical-cas): How-to guide for creating and reading cash flow statements with LivePlan
- [17 Vital Business Plan Mistakes to Avoid in 2026](https://timberry.bplans.com/top-10-planning-mistake-9-pitching-without-planning): Guide to avoiding common business plan mistakes for lenders and investors
- [6 Things That Can Kill Business Growth — And What To Do About Them](https://timberry.bplans.com/the-phenomenon-of-business-momentum): Guide to identifying and overcoming business growth obstacles with LivePlan

## Startup Funding & Investment

- [Finding a Consultant to Find Investors](https://timberry.bplans.com/about-finding-a-consultant-to-find-investors): Q&A on finding angel investors and startup funding resources
- [A Great Case for Innovative Angel Loan Financing](https://timberry.bplans.com/innovative-angel-loan-financing): Tim Berry discusses alternative angel loan financing for startups
- [True Story: Why We Bought Out Our VC Investors](https://timberry.bplans.com/true-story-why-we-bought-out-our-vc-investors): Tim Berry's story of Palo Alto Software's venture capital buyout

## Business Philosophy & Leadership

- [Work on Stuff That Matters](https://timberry.bplans.com/work-on): Tim Berry's perspective on business values and creating meaningful work
- [Yes, Happy Employees Make Good Companies](https://timberry.bplans.com/yes-happy-emplo): Tim Berry on employee engagement and company culture in business
- [Business Self Help: You Can't be an Original by Copying](https://timberry.bplans.com/business-self-h): Tim Berry on business originality versus copying successful companies
- [Are You Buying the 80-Hour Myth?](https://timberry.bplans.com/are-you-buying): Tim Berry on work-life balance and startup culture myths

## Commentary & Insights

- [Are Main Street and Wall Street Going Down Together?](https://timberry.bplans.com/are-main-street-and-wall-street-going-down-together): Tim Berry's commentary on economic crisis and corporate responsibility
- [TED Talk: We Stopped Being Wise](https://timberry.bplans.com/so-here-i-am-with-another-video-recommendation-today-second-day-in-a-row-it-wasnt-intentional-but-i-got-an-email-from-the): Tim Berry's review of Barry Schwartz's TED talk on wisdom and crisis management
- [What? Scientists in Business? Rice Scores Big.](https://timberry.bplans.com/what-scientists): Tim Berry's account of judging Rice University's 2008 business plan competition
- [Your Brain on Drugs? No, Your Brain on Computers.](https://timberry.bplans.com/your-brain-on-drugs-no-your-brain-on-constant-connection): Tim Berry's reflection on digital distraction and constant connectivity
- [On the Value of Good Computer Games](https://timberry.bplans.com/the-value-of-good-computer-games): Tim Berry on computer games and learning for business and strategy
